import os
from typing import Any, Dict

import requests


AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET"
AUTH0_CONNECTION_ENV = "AUTH0_CONNECTION"


class EmailPasswordLoginError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def email_password_login(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    domain = os.environ.get(AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV)
    client_id = os.environ.get(AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV)
    client_secret = os.environ.get(AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV)
    connection = os.environ.get(AUTH0_CONNECTION_ENV, "Username-Password-Authentication")
    if not domain or not client_id or not client_secret:
        raise EmailPasswordLoginError("Missing Auth0 configuration")

    resp = requests.post(
        f"https://{domain}/oauth/token",
        json={
            "grant_type": "http://auth0.com/oauth/grant-type/password-realm",
            "client_id": client_id,
            "client_secret": client_secret,
            "username": email,
            "password": password,
            "realm": connection,
            "scope": "openid profile email offline_access",
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        raise EmailPasswordLoginError(f"Auth0 login failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")

    data = resp.json()
    if "access_token" not in data or "id_token" not in data:
        raise EmailPasswordLoginError("Auth0 login response missing tokens")
    return data

+

+

+OKTA_TOKEN_URL = "https://{domain}/oauth2/{authorization_server}/v1/token"
+
+
+def refresh_session(refresh_token: str, *, okta_domain: Optional[str] = None, client_id: Optional[str] = None, client_secret: Optional[str] = None, authorization_server: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    domain = okta_domain or os.environ.get("OKTA_DOMAIN")
+    cid = client_id or os.environ.get("OKTA_CLIENT_ID")
+    secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET")

+    if not domain or not cid or not secret:
+        raise ValueError("OKTA_DOMAIN, OKTA_CLIENT_ID, and OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+    url = OKTA_TOKEN_URL.format(domain=domain, authorization_server=auth_server)

+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
+        data={
+            "grant_type": "refresh_token",
+            "refresh_token": refresh_token,
+            "client_id": cid,
+            "client_secret": secret,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()

+        "refresh_token": token_data.get("refresh_token", refresh_token),
+        "id_token": token_data.get("id_token"),
+        "token_type": token_data.get("token_type"),
+        "expires_in": token_data.get("expires_in"),

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET"
+
+
+class RegisterUserError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str, connection: Optional[str] = None, name: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    domain = os.environ.get(AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV)
+    client_id = os.environ.get(AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV)
+    client_secret = os.environ.get(AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV)
+    if not domain or not client_id or not client_secret:
+        raise RegisterUserError("Missing Auth0 configuration")
+
+    url = f"https://{domain}/api/v2/users"
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "email": email,
+        "password": password,
+        "connection": connection or "Username-Password-Authentication",
+    }
+    if name:
+        payload["name"] = name
+
+    token_resp = requests.post(
+        f"https://{domain}/oauth/token",
+        json={
+            "grant_type": "client_credentials",
+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "client_secret": client_secret,
+            "audience": f"https://{domain}/api/v2/",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    if token_resp.status_code >= 400:
+        raise RegisterUserError(f"Auth0 token request failed: {token_resp.status_code} {token_resp.text}")
+
+    access_token = token_resp.json().get("access_token")
+    if not access_token:
+        raise RegisterUserError("Auth0 token response missing access_token")
+
+    resp = requests.post(
+        url,
+        json=payload,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    if resp.status_code >= 400:
+        raise RegisterUserError(f"Auth0 user creation failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")
+    return resp.json()
+
*** End Patch
